newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys 28,500 tonnes sunflower oil-trade.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 28,500 tonnes sunflower oil-trade.

text.p: Cairo-based traders said on Wednesday Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries bought 28,500 tonnes of sunflower oil at $560 per tonne for delivery in the second half of August.
The traders said Egypt had bought the oil from Swiss firm Andre.
They added that Egypt had scrapped its tenders for cotton seed oil and soya bean oil due to high prices.
The holding firm had originally tendered for 25,000 to 40,000 tonnes of cotton seed, sunflower seed and soya bean oils for delivery in August.
